title: Babies
overview: From nature to nurture, this docuseries explores the groundbreaking science that reveals how infants discover life during their very first year.

title: Cooked
overview: Explored through the lenses of the four natural elements – fire, water, air and earth – COOKED is an enlightening and compelling look at the evolution of what food means to us through the history of food preparation and its universal ability to connect us. Highlighting our primal human need to cook, the series urges a return to the kitchen to reclaim our lost traditions and to forge a deeper, more meaningful connection to the ingredients and cooking techniques that we use to nourish ourselves.

title: Coronavirus, Explained
overview: In 2020, the world changed. This topical series examines the coronavirus pandemic, the efforts to combat it and ways to manage its mental health toll.

title: Countdown: Inspiration4 Mission to Space
overview: From training to launch to landing, this all-access docuseries rides along with the Inspiration4 crew on the first all-civilian orbital space mission.

title: Explained
overview: This enlightening series from Vox digs into a wide range of topics such as the rise of cryptocurrency, why diets fail, and the wild world of K-pop.

title: Headspace Guide to Meditation
overview: The series shows how meditation can help in your daily life. From tackling stress to embracing gratitude, each episode first teaches the basics and techniques of the practice, and then concludes with a guided meditation. Push play, close your eyes, and explore the many benefits of meditation.

title: High Score
overview: This docuseries traces the history of classic video games, featuring insights from the innovators who brought these worlds and characters to life.

title: Inside Bill's Brain: Decoding Bill Gates
overview: Take a trip inside the mind of Bill Gates as the billionaire opens up about those who influenced him and the audacious goals he's still pursuing.

title: Mystery Lab
overview: Host Felipe Castanhari explores science, history, mysteries and marvels, uncovering mind-blowing facts with help from his lab buddies.

title: Our Planet: Behind the Scenes
overview: Years spent recording footage of creatures from every corner of the globe is bound to produce a bit of drama. Here's a behind-the-scenes look.

title: Rotten
overview: This docuseries travels deep into the heart of the food supply chain to reveal unsavory truths and expose hidden forces that shape what we eat.

title: Spycraft
overview: The spy game is a serious business, and throughout history, the tools and technologies developed for it have mattered as much as the spies themselves.

title: Tales by Light
overview: Behind every powerful image is a powerful story. Uniting exploration, photography and the natural world, Tales By Light follows photographers from Australia and around the world as they push the limits of their craft.

title: The Secret Life of Our Pets
overview: With the help of the latest science and new camera technology, this exciting show reveals that our pets are hiding incredible superpowers and quirks of evolution.

title: The Mind, Explained
overview: Ever wonder what's happening inside your head? From dreaming to anxiety disorders, discover how your brain works with this illuminating series.

title: The Surgeon's Cut
overview: They're philosophers, storytellers and pioneers in their fields. Four surgeons reflect on their lives and professions in this inspiring docuseries.

title: This Is a Gardening Show
overview: Zach Galifianakis digs into the world of gardening, interviewing curious kids and eccentric experts in a funny, oddball celebration of the food we eat.

title: Unnatural Selection
overview: From eradicating disease to selecting a child's traits, gene editing gives humans the chance to hack biology. Meet the real people behind the science.

title: White Rabbit Project
overview: Kari Byron, Tory Belleci and Grant Imahara rank history's greatest inventions, heists and more.

title: A Tragedy Foretold: Flight 3054
overview: The untold stories and human tragedy behind Latin America's deadliest air disaster are investigated in this three-part documentary series.

title: Alexander: The Making of a God
overview: Expert interviews and gripping reenactments combine to reveal the extraordinary life of Alexander the Great and his burning desire to conquer the world.

title: All the Sharks
overview: Four teams of shark experts and enthusiasts travel the globe trying to find the most elusive shark species in this fin-tastic reality competition.

title: Animal
overview: This immersive series follows the world's most magnificent creatures, capturing never-before-seen moments from the heartwarming to the outrageous.

title: Bad Surgeon: Love Under the Knife
overview: Dr. Paolo Macchiarini is world famous for his revolutionary stem cell-infused windpipe transplants. There's just one problem: His patients keep dying.

title: Challenger: The Final Flight
overview: Engineers, officials and the crew members' families provide their perspective on the 1986 Space Shuttle Challenger disaster and its aftermath.

title: Chimp Empire
overview: A vast community of chimpanzees thrives in a forest in Uganda, navigating complex social politics, family dynamics and dangerous territory disputes.

title: Critical: Between Life and Death
overview: From critical emergencies to the operating room, this documentary series follows London's trauma centres as they treat the most severely injured.

title: Emergency: NYC
overview: This gripping docuseries follows New York City's frontline medical professionals as they balance the intensity of their work with their personal lives.

title: How to Change Your Mind
overview: Author Michael Pollan leads the way in this docuseries exploring the history and uses of psychedelics, including LSD, psilocybin, MDMA and mescaline.

title: Island of the Sea Wolves
overview: Explore wild, wondrous Vancouver Island, where the ocean nurtures all life, from bald eagles who go fishing to sea wolves who swim in frigid waters.

title: Attenborough's Life in Colour
overview: Exploring the vital role colour plays in the daily lives of many species.

title: Life on Our Planet
overview: Life's extraordinary journey to conquer, adapt and survive on Earth across billions of years comes alive in this groundbreaking nature docuseries.

title: Mark Rober's CrunchLabs
overview: At CrunchLabs, Mark Rober transforms wild ideas into reality, blending engineering and outrageous fun for science adventures you'll never forget.

title: Night on Earth
overview: This nature series’ new technology lifts night’s veil to reveal the hidden lives of the world’s creatures, from lions on the hunt to bats on the wing.

title: Nightmares of Nature
overview: Chilling tales of survival unfurl in this documentary series that captures the drama, danger and dark beauty of nature from the perspective of its prey.

title: Our Great National Parks
overview: Narrated by former President Barack Obama, this stunning docuseries shines the spotlight on some of the planet's most spectacular national parks.

title: Our Living World
overview: This stunning nature series narrated by Cate Blanchett explores the intelligence, resourcefulness and interconnectedness of life on our planet.

title: Our Oceans
overview: Discover the stories beneath the surface of the water in this stunning nature documentary series, which explores each of the Earth's five oceans.

title: Our Universe
overview: Witness the remarkable story of our universe over billions of years and its inextricable link to life on Earth in this sweeping documentary series.

title: Secret World of Sound
overview: Anthony Morgan explores the extraordinary ways that animals hear and produce sound, and the crucial role sound plays in the lives of animals around the globe - from birth to surviving adulthood and finding a mate.

title: The Dinosaurs
overview: From the first dinosaurs to the last, this epic documentary series examines their 165 million years on Earth and the forces that shaped their evolution.

title: The TikTok Killer
overview: When Esther vanishes without a trace, her family is able to piece together her last movements thanks to José Jurado Montilla, a traveler who journeys across Spain sharing heartfelt videos of his trips on his TikTok account. But “Dynamite” Montilla – the last person to have been with Esther – hides a dark past

title: My Encounter with Evil
overview: Real people who believe their lives were touched by demonic possession recount their experiences through reenactments and testimonies.

title: Young Royals Forever
overview: From casting to the final scene, this special shows how the cast and crew of "Young Royals" brought Wilhelm and Simon's heartwarming journey to life.

title: Roman Empire
overview: This stylish mix of documentary and historical epic chronicles the reign of Commodus, the emperor whose rule marked the beginning of Rome's fall.
